title: 第一卷 第329章 你爹没教你做人
slug: 纨绔世子爷公主退婚我造反
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

周公子坐在地上，整个人都是懵的。

从小到大。

他挨过骂。

挨过训。

也挨过他爹的戒尺。

但在听雪楼，当着这么多人，被人一巴掌抽坐地上。

这事他真没经历过。

他身后那几个家奴也懵。

主要是陈炎打得太顺手。

没有前摇。

没有废话蓄力。

抬手就来。

像是吃饭夹菜一样自然。

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

Mr. Zhou sat on the ground, completely confused.

From childhood to adulthood.

He got scolded.

Got trained.

He also suffered from his father's ruler.

But in Tingxue Tower, in front of so many people, I was slapped and sat on the ground.

He has never experienced this before.

The slaves behind him were also confused.

Mainly because Chen Yan played too smoothly.

No forward sway.

No bullshit charge.

Raise your hand and come.

It's as natural as picking up vegetables while eating.

Page (1/3)
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 329 Your father didn’t teach you how to be a good person
